title: 'Example Of A Leader': Emmanuel Emegha In Awe Of Chelsea Teammate Who Motivates The Team

 Gerry Crisandy Partner Nov 21, 2026 12:03 PM Published Nov 21, 2026 12:03 PM Emegha has opened up about his slow start at Chelsea and how captain James has made his first months at the club a lot easier.
 More Videos Emmanuel Emegha has described Chelsea teammate Reece James as “the best captain” he has ever had in his career and highlighted the defender’s supportive attitude in training.
 Moving to a new club and a new country can be difficult for some players. Especially for Emegha, who has not had the best start to his career at Chelsea .
 He officially joined Chelsea in the summer on a deal that was agreed in September 2025. He unfortunately had to miss most of pre-season due to a hamstring injury he sustained during a behind-closed-doors friendly against League One side Bromley. He scored in the eventual 3-0 win, but it proved costly.
 He had only managed to get on the bench once until he overcame the injury and finally made the team sheet in Chelsea’s 2-0 win over Manchester United in October. 
 Related stories
 The 23-year-old made his long-awaited competitive Chelsea debut in the Carabao Cup defeat to Liverpool in late October. He has so far played 25 minutes of football across two substitute appearances and is still waiting for his first start for the club.
 Manager Xabi Alonso has previously praised Emegha’s physical attributes, and the striker himself is confident in his outstanding athleticism.
 “I’m quick,” Emegha said about his characteristics on the Chelsea programme ahead of Saturday’s clash with Leeds United .
 “I know how to make runs in behind, and I know that I can be a nightmare for all defenders.”
 However, he also understands that his injury absences have led to questions about his ability. Unsurprisingly, he is eager to prove himself.
 “Nobody has seen me yet. They will,” he added.
 “I know everybody was like, ‘Where is he?’ or some things like this, but it will come. And I know that, when my time comes, I will be ready, and I know that the stadium will love my energy.”
 James has made Emegha feel welcome
 The Netherlands international admitted that the environment at Chelsea is quite different than what he is used to. But he is still enjoying his time surrounded by “talented” players.
 “Before coming, I knew that I could expect a high level, but I didn’t know that it would be so crazy high,” he admitted.
 “I also want to say that Reece James is the best captain I’ve ever had in my whole life. I came to this club, and he made me comfortable.
 “Reece James… he has won it all; he has seen it all, but he’s still so caring.
 “I don’t know how it is for other players, but Joao (Pedro) said it too. One day we had a meeting, and he said the same thing.
 “For me, Reece is the example of a leader. He would come to me and make sure that I felt good. If I had a tough training session, he would come to me and tell me, ‘It’s normal. Tomorrow is a new day. Forget it and move on.’”
 “If I missed an open chance in training, it would be easy to say, ‘Oh, come on!’
 “But Reece… he (might have) thought, ‘Oh, come on!’ but he said, ‘No, come on. Next one, next one!’
 “And he wasn’t even in my team that session! He made me feel so good.”
 Emegha has now overcome his injury issues, and he admitted that missing games due to injuries, as he did, would not work if he wants to continue playing at a “big club” like Chelsea.
 He mentioned that his next challenges are to stay fit and to score his first Chelsea goal. “That’s my goal!” he concluded.
 It remains unclear whether Emegha would play a part when Chelsea host Leeds United at Stamford Bridge this weekend. On paper, the last several weeks should be the perfect opportunities for Emegha and Danny Welbeck given Joao Pedro’s knee injury absence.
 However, in the last four games that Joao Pedro has missed, Alonso has only opted to start with a natural striker once, against Liverpool, and it was Welbeck.
 Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers started as a front two against Tottenham Hotspur, and Pedro Neto operated as a centre forward in the last two games against Manchester United and Sunderland.
 Emegha will hope to get his opportunity against Leeds and finally prove that Chelsea were right to sign him and keep him in their first-team squad this season.
